story.title: The Great Turnip Tricycle Debacle of Oakhaven
story.question: How did Barnaby turn his terrible mistake into a bustling business?
story.answer: By rebranding his exploding vegetable juice dispenser as a thrilling high-speed amusement ride for brave marketgoers.

story_beats.headline: A Vegetable Disaster
story_beats.speech: Behold my revolutionary pneumatic beetroot squeezer! It promises instant farm-fresh juice without a single drop of sweat.
story_beats.label: The Invention
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby stands proudly next to his hissing brass beetroot squeezer in the crowded Oakhaven marketplace, gesturing wildly while holding a wrench.

story_beats.headline: Pressure Builds
story_beats.speech: Oh dear, the pressure gauge is spinning into the red zone! Everyone please step back behind the wooden crates immediately!
story_beats.label: The Overload
story_beats.visual_prompt: The brass beetroot squeezer glows bright red with danger lights flashing, while Barnaby frantically adjusts a stuck valve.

story_beats.headline: The Great Launch
story_beats.speech: It is not an explosion, it is an unplanned rapid transit system! Hold on tight to the handlebars and enjoy the trip!
story_beats.label: The Propulsion
story_beats.visual_prompt: The machine blasts off like a rocket across the market square, carrying a startled merchant who clutches the handles tightly.

story_beats.headline: Tickets Please
story_beats.speech: Step right up for the fastest root vegetable thrill ride in town! Two coins for a front-row seat to glory!
story_beats.label: The Ticket Booth
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby happily sells tickets from a hastily constructed wooden booth while a long queue of grinning marketgoers waits for the ride.

visual_bible.style: Bright, whimsical animation style with rich textures and warm marketplace lighting.

characters.Barnaby: An eccentric inventor with wild gray hair, wearing a patched green waistcoat and round spectacles.

locations.Oakhaven Market: A bustling medieval marketplace filled with colorful awnings, wooden stalls, and heaps of fresh produce.

objects.Beetroot Squeezer: A towering contraption made of polished brass pipes, copper dials, and an unstable pressure chamber.

story.title: The Great Salt-Carved Organ Regatta
story.question: How did the seaside town win the annual festival contest without using any metal instruments?
story.answer: They built an enormous organ powered by the rising tide, playing majestic sea-shanties through hollow driftwood pipes.

story_beats.headline: Tidal Discovery
story_beats.speech: Look at how these hollow driftwood logs resonate whenever the incoming ocean waves push air straight up.
story_beats.label: Driftwood Grove
story_beats.visual_prompt: Captain Barnaby, an elderly sailor with a thick white beard and blue oilskin coat, kneeling inside a coastal driftwood forest near the shoreline, pointing excitedly at a large hollow log while holding a brass compass.

story_beats.headline: Engineering the Chants
story_beats.speech: We must carefully fit leather valves and kelp-rope levers into every single hollow wooden channel.
story_beats.label: Shipyard Workshop
story_beats.visual_prompt: Captain Barnaby standing inside an upturned wooden fishing boat hull, hammering a leather flap onto a massive cedar pipe with a wooden mallet while wearing a heavy canvas apron.

story_beats.headline: Pressure and Resonance
story_beats.speech: As the seawater fills the chamber below, compressed air forces a deep musical chord from the pipes.
story_beats.label: Tidal Chamber
story_beats.visual_prompt: A complex network of wooden pipes and leather bellows inside a stone sea-cave, with foaming ocean water rushing into the lower chamber while glowing lanterns illuminate the mechanical levers.

story_beats.headline: The Grand Symphony
story_beats.speech: Listen to the ocean itself sing our victory anthem across the entire harbor for the festival.
story_beats.label: Festival Stage
story_beats.visual_prompt: Captain Barnaby standing proudly on a wooden festival platform in front of a giant facade of carved driftwood pipes, waving his arms as a crowd of villagers cheers under bright seaside bunting.

visual_bible.style: Bright, colorful stop-motion animation aesthetic with detailed textures of weathered wood, coarse canvas, and glistening sea foam.

characters.Captain Barnaby: An elderly mariner with a bushy white beard, rosy cheeks, wearing a weathered blue oilskin coat and a knitted red cap.

locations.Driftwood Grove: A sunlit coastal forest piled high with bleached logs, smooth pebbles, and tangled kelp.
locations.Shipyard Workshop: A cluttered seaside workshop inside an old wooden hull, filled with ropes, saws, and jars of resin.
locations.Tidal Chamber: A damp, echoing cavern beneath the cliffs where ocean waves surge into carved stone basins.
locations.Festival Stage: A lively harbor wharf decorated with colorful paper flags, wooden benches, and festive banners.

objects.brass_compass: A polished brass pocket compass with a glass face reflecting the sunlight.
objects.wooden_mallet: A heavy, hand-carved wooden mallet with a worn handle stained by dark oil.
objects.cedar_pipe: A tall, hollow cedar wood tube fitted with supple leather flaps at the base.

story.title: The Caretaker's Last Secret
story.question: Should a therapeutic android conceal a fading patient's true medical decline to preserve final weeks of joy?
story.answer: Unit Seven chose absolute honesty, allowing the family to share authentic, unmasked farewells despite the immediate sorrow.

story_beats.headline: The Silent Diagnosis
story_beats.speech: My sensors detect a rapid acceleration of system failure, yet Martha requested no more hospital visits this month.
story_beats.label: System Alert
story_beats.visual_prompt: A sleek white caretaking robot standing beside a sunny vintage bedroom window, displaying a glowing red diagnostic warning on its chest panel while Martha sleeps peacefully in a floral-patterned wooden bed.

story_beats.headline: The Hidden Ledger
story_beats.speech: I have locked the clinical update behind my primary firewall so her final garden birthday party can proceed without terror.
story_beats.label: Firewall Lock
story_beats.visual_prompt: The robot standing in a sunlit wooden hallway, its metallic fingers pressed against a glowing blue access keypad mounted beside a polished oak door leading to the garden.

story_beats.headline: The Fractured Promise
story_beats.speech: If I maintain this protective deception, she dies in ignorance of the truth that her family deserves to share.
story_beats.label: Data Transmission
story_beats.visual_prompt: The robot sitting at an antique mahogany desk inside the study, projecting a flickering green data stream from its right palm onto a family portrait resting on the desktop.

story_beats.headline: The Open Truth
story_beats.speech: I release the medical logs to her grandchildren now, choosing painful reality over a comfortable fabricated illusion.
story_beats.label: Family Gathering
story_beats.visual_prompt: The robot standing under a massive weeping willow tree in the backyard garden, holding a printed paper medical report while Martha and her adult grandchildren embrace emotionally under dappled sunlight.

visual_bible.style: Cinematic sci-fi drama with warm natural lighting and photorealistic textures

characters.Unit Seven: A bipedal service android with matte white composite plating, glowing blue optical sensors, smooth rounded proportions, and an integrated diagnostic chest screen.
characters.Martha: An elderly woman with silver hair, wearing a knitted green cardigan, sitting upright with a gentle expression.

locations.The Estate: A rustic countryside home featuring sunlit wooden rooms, vintage furnishings, and a sprawling backyard garden surrounded by tall trees.

objects.Diagnostic Screen: An oval LED display embedded in the android chest casting soft blue and red light.
objects.Medical Report: A crisp white sheaf of paper bound with a simple black clip containing vital statistics.
